apis.data.catalog.page: {rootId,cursor?:string|null,pageSize?:1..200}; use FIXER forthcoming shared/data-catalog-schema.ts CatalogResultSchema; metadata only, state complete|partial|denied|unavailable, entries, cursor, scannedEntries, typed reason.
